description: Search the BLS series catalog by natural language query, survey code, geographic area, or keywords to resolve cryptic SeriesIDs. Returns matching series with decoded components (survey, area, item, seasonal flag, and publication frequency for surveys that publish one series at several frequencies) and plain-language names, ranked by relevance and paged with limit and offset. Use this before bls_get_series when you have a concept but not a SeriesID. Operates offline against an index of the major surveys — no API quota consumed. Survey filter accepts the two-letter code of an indexed survey (CU, AP, CE, LN, LA, PC, WP, JT, EC, PR, MP, CW, CM, CI; OE only when the server sets BLS_CATALOG_INCLUDE_OES=true); series in other surveys are fetched by SeriesID with bls_get_series. Area filter accepts state names, MSA names, or FIPS area codes.

area.description: State name, MSA name, or FIPS area code to narrow results to a geographic area — a case-insensitive substring of the area name, title, or SeriesID. Omit for national series, which then rank first among equal matches.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–50, default 10).

offset.description: Number of ranked results to skip, for paging past the first page (default 0). Pass nextOffset from the previous response to get the next page.

query.description: Natural language or keyword query (e.g. "unemployment rate", "CPI food", "nonfarm payrolls"). Also accepts a SeriesID directly for exact lookup.

seasonal_adjustment.description: When true, return only seasonally adjusted series. When false, return only not-seasonally-adjusted. Omit to return both.

survey.description: Two-letter LABSTAT survey abbreviation to filter results, case-insensitive (e.g. CU for CPI, CE for CES, LN for CPS, LA for LAUS, JT for JOLTS). Indexed surveys: CU, AP, CE, LN, LA, PC, WP, JT, EC, PR, MP, CW, CM, CI; OE (OEWS) only when the server sets BLS_CATALOG_INCLUDE_OES=true. Omit to search all indexed surveys.

name: bls_search_series

areaFilter.description: Area filter applied, trimmed. Absent when no area filter was passed or it was blank.

cap.description: The result limit that capped the returned list.

capped.description: True when the FTS candidate pool, after the survey/area/seasonal filters, reached the internal cap (~1000). totalCount is then a lower bound and offset paging stops at the pool. Narrow the query, add filters, or use a direct SeriesID to get an exact count.

catalogSize.description: Total series in the loaded catalog index. Distinguishes an empty-result search from a failed catalog load.

effectiveQuery.description: Query string as the server received and searched on. Confirms interpretation for self-correction.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `catalog_unavailable`: The catalog index failed to load at startup. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limitApplied.description: Result limit in effect (defaults to 10 when omitted).

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next page. Present only when truncated is true.

notice.description: Guidance on the result: the survey is not in the offline index, the offset is past the last result, nothing matched, which offset fetches the next page, or, on the last page of a capped list, that other series may also match. Absent when this page ends an uncapped list with results.

offsetApplied.description: Offset in effect (defaults to 0 when omitted).

seasonalFilter.description: Seasonal-adjustment filter applied, if any. Absent when not passed.

frequency.description: Publication frequency — "Monthly", "Semi-Annual", "Quarterly", or "Annual" — for CU, CW, and LN, which publish one series at several frequencies under the same title. Absent for other surveys.

item.description: Item or subject name, when decoded.

seasonal.description: Seasonality descriptor matching the data-tool form: "Seasonally Adjusted" or "Not Seasonally Adjusted".

seriesId.description: BLS SeriesID — pass to bls_get_series or bls_get_latest to fetch data.

shown.description: Number of series returned in this response.

surveyFilter.description: Survey filter applied, trimmed and uppercased. Absent when no survey filter was passed or it was blank.

totalCount.description: Total ranked results after every filter (area included), before limit and offset. A lower bound when capped is true — the catalog index may contain more matching series.

truncated.description: True when ranked results remain past this page; nextOffset fetches them.

title: Search BLS Series
